description: This file defines a Spring MVC controller class 'ContractController' that manages contract-related web requests such as creating, accepting, and printing contracts within a web application.

classes.name: ContractController
classes.description: A Spring MVC controller handling HTTP requests related to contract management, including creating, accepting, and printing contracts.

methods.name: newContract
methods.description: Handles GET requests to display a form for creating a new contract for a specific client.

methods.name: registerUser
methods.description: Handles POST requests to create and save a new contract, or send it for approval.

methods.name: acceptContract
methods.description: Handles GET requests to accept a specific contract if the user is authorized.

methods.name: printContract
methods.description: Handles GET requests to print a contract if it has been accepted.
